posts.title: September Notes / Whats Next
posts.description: The first half of september was all about getting Build 4067 and its improvements and fixes out the door, as well as website changes. There is one more feature-build planned (4068) that contains a significant feature still missing from Dragontail, which is re-integrating the ridge breaking mode into flow restructure. posts.title: Wrapping August
posts.description: Along with the Meshify improvements mentioned last time, the main push for the next build 4067 is build system quality of life improvements.
